reviewed_boundaries: Shared private git() caller census: authority diff metadata, ledger path list and merge-marker bodies, candidate source readText, tracked regular-file ls-tree checks, receipt bodies/metadata and CLI registry/jurisdiction loading.
createConsoleCandidateSourceResolver still validates signed candidate and signed direct single-parent authority child, authority-only diff and every merge-marker body before returning resolver.
Fixed16MiB execFileSync maxBuffer changes capacity, not arguments, encoding, shell behavior, signature verification, repository path rules, tracked file modes, parser, digest or promotion state.
Synchronous overflow still throws; readText converts it to existing missing-source error and gitSucceeds returnsfalse, both failclosed. No truncation or prefix acceptance is proposed.
Authority-train and SSH policy helpers read small metadata or allowed-signers separately; no demonstrated need to change those limits.
exact_test_expectations: Use real signed candidate/authority fixture with marker-free authority text above1MiB and assert resolver construction succeeds.
Assert large candidate readText output exact full bytes or digest plus length, including a unique tail after1MiB; reading only prefix is not positive control.
Place an asymmetric unresolved merge marker after1MiB in an authority document; assert specific merge-marker rejection, not any generic throw. Prefer all3 existing asymmetric marker variants.
Above16MiB actualGit blob must reject; assertion must establish no resolver/source output was returned. Keep checks at real exported boundary, not a mocked helper.
Retain existing regular/missing/symlink candidate source tests unchanged and verify their3ENOBUFS failures are resolved.
risks_and_limits: 16MiB is child-process output capacity per stream, not a16MiB total process-memory cap; buffer copies, decoded strings and split lines consume additional bounded-factor memory.
Signed high-cardinality file lists or receipts can still exceed16MiB and must continue rejecting; observed overflow is a measured replacement trigger for reviewed bounded streaming.
Approval covers exact design for test authoring only; exact test review,RED lane admission,implementation review andGREEN are still required.
